chemistry-m3-q5.s.s1.prompt: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na oxygen nke ukwuu n'okpomọkụ ụlọ. Mgbe etinyere obere ntụ black manganese dioxide (MnO₂), ụfụfụ (oxygen gas) pụtara dị ka mgbawa. Kedu ọrụ manganese dioxide?

chemistry-killer-09.title: Mole
chemistry-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-09.material: N'ime mmeghachi omume $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$, ebe gas A na B na-emeghachi omume ka ha mepụta gas C n'okpomọkụ na nrụgide edoro, A 20 mL na B 60 mL na-emeghachi omume n'enweghị ịkarị ma ọ bụ ịgbagha ma mepụta C 40 mL. Oke molecule nke A bụ 28, nke B bụ 2, ma e mere ka ngwakọta gas 100 mL nke A na B (oke molecule nkezi 12.4) meghachi omume kpamkpam n'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide. Mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị, nkpuru ngwakọta gas bụ okpukpu ole nke tupu mmeghachi omume?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: N'ime mmeghachi omume $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$, ebe gas A na B na-emeghachi omume ka ha mepụta gas C n'okpomọkụ na nrụgide edoro, A 20 mL na B 60 mL na-emeghachi omume n'enweghị ịkarị ma ọ bụ ịgbagha ma mepụta C 40 mL. Oke molecule nke A bụ 28, nke B bụ 2, ma e mere ka ngwakọta gas 100 mL nke A na B (oke molecule nkezi 12.4) meghachi omume kpamkpam n'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide. Mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị, nkpuru ngwakọta gas bụ okpukpu ole nke tupu mmeghachi omume?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ọnụọgụ olu A:B:C = 20:60:40 = 1:3:2, ya bụ $\mathrm{A + 3B \rightarrow 2C}$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: N'ime ngwakọta gas 100 mL, olu A bụ x: (28x + 2(100 − x))/100 = 12.4 → 26x + 200 = 1240 → x = 40 mL. Ya mere A 40 mL, B 60 mL.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Mgbe B 60 mL niile meghachiri, A 20 mL ejiri ma C 40 mL a mepụtara. Mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị A 20 mL + C 40 mL = 60 mL.
Nzọụkwụ 4: A na-echekwa oke (nyocha site na oke molecule: tupu mmeghachi omume 40×28 + 60×2 = 1240, mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị oke molecule C (28+3×2)/2 = 17, 20×28 + 40×17 = 1240). N'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide, nkpuru = oke/olu, ya mere mgbe/tupu = 100/60 = 5/3.
Azịza: 5/3 (a). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 3/5 bụ ọnụọgụ edere n'ụzọ nke ọzọ, 1 lere naanị nchekwa oke anya ma leghara mgbanwe olu anya, 5/4 weere na A 40 mL fọdụrụ ma tụọ ngụkọta dị ka 80 mL)

chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
